"tickets": [
{
"title": "Prepare written household account map",
"text": "Prepare a written household account map for Dana Bramblequill that distinguishes her premarital savings, individual brokerage account, rental condo cash flows, joint Teacup Comet Bank accounts, and the shared expense funding arrangement.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2026-08-02",
"assigneeId": null,
"templateId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Dana requested a written household account map distinguishing her premarital savings, individual brokerage account, rental condo cash flows, joint Teacup Comet Bank accounts, and shared expense funding arrangement; this was agreed for 2026-08-02."
},
{
"title": "Verify recurring payment change",
"text": "Complete these checks before confirming the recurring payment change:\n- Identify the payment being changed, including payee, funding account, frequency, and approximate amount.\n- Confirm whether the request is to add, stop, pause, resume, or modify the payment.\n- Verify client authorization using the firm's required authentication process.\n- Confirm the effective processing window and whether any payment is already pending.\n- Check for linked services, loan obligations, insurance premiums, charitable pledges, or household bills that could be affected.\n- Document the new instructions and retain confirmation from the custodian, biller, or payment platform.\n- Notify the client when the change is submitted and again when confirmation is received.\nReview Dana Bramblequill's scheduled transfer from her individual Teacup Comet Bank account and the new joint‑account transfer that both target the townhouse mortgage contribution, to resolve the duplicate funding risk.",
"priority": "high",
"dueDate": "2026-07-16",
"assigneeId": null,
"templateId": "fbbdddd5-865b-51c3-a01a-013cd6ced637",
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Dana reported that a scheduled transfer from her individual Teacup Comet Bank account and a new joint-account transfer both appear tied to the townhouse mortgage contribution, creating a risk of duplicate household funding for the same payment cycle; the agreed follow-up on the recurring mortgage contribution issue is dated 2026-07-16."
},
{
"title": "Collect address and residency update details",
"text": "Use this form to document a household address or residency change.\n\nClient full name: Oliver Cloudpuddle\nHousehold members affected: Dana Bramblequill, Oliver Cloudpuddle\nPrior mailing address: \nNew mailing address: Portland, Oregon townhouse (shared residence)\nNew physical address, if different: Portland, Oregon townhouse\nEffective date of move or residency change: \nPrimary phone number to confirm: \nEmail address to confirm: \nState or jurisdiction of prior tax residency: \nState or jurisdiction of new tax residency: Oregon\nDriver's license or state ID updated? \nVoter registration updated? \nEmployer/payroll address updated? \nCustodian address update needed? \nInsurance carrier address update needed? \nEstate documents may need review due to state change? \nNotes for advisor review: \n\nUpdate the advisory household record and non‑trading contact fields to reflect Oliver Cloudpuddle’s full legal name, shared Portland townhouse address, and contact details as provided.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2026-07-18",
"assigneeId": null,
"templateId": "6e53670b-6e08-512a-b234-e889efdc384e",
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Dana provided Oliver’s full legal name, shared residence, preferred household mailing address, and contact details so the advisory household record and non-trading contact fields can be updated separately from that authorization; the agreed update is dated 2026-07-18."
},
{
"title": "Update Dana Bramblequill beneficiary designations",
"text": "Update the beneficiary designations for Dana Bramblequill’s IRA, taxable transfer‑on‑death registration (if available), Moonbadger Design Labs 401(k), and group life insurance coverage to reflect her marriage to Oliver Cloudpuddle and compare contingent beneficiary options.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2026-07-25",
"assigneeId": null,
"templateId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Dana asked for help updating beneficiary designations on her IRA, taxable transfer-on-death registration if available, Moonbadger Design Labs 401(k), and group life coverage to reflect her marriage and to compare contingent beneficiary options; the agreed follow-up is dated 2026-07-25."
},
{
"title": "Complete policy renewal follow-up",
"text": "Use this workflow when a client receives a renewal notice or upcoming renewal reminder for an insurance, benefits, or protection policy. Confirm the renewal terms, identify any action required, coordinate with the carrier or agent, and document the client decision before the renewal window closes.\n\nObtain the Lavender Sprocket Insurance renewal notice and current declarations page for Oliver Cloudpuddle’s $750,000 term life policy to address the near‑term renewal response window.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2026-08-05",
"assigneeId": "6c042427-5f72-5342-b648-35e8432ac742",
"templateId": "b4b28e1a-9a89-5911-87af-edffbf515fb3",
"subTasks": [
{
"title": "Collect renewal notice and current policy details",
"text": "Request or locate the renewal notice, current declarations page, premium summary, coverage limits, named insured details, beneficiary or owner information if applicable, and any stated renewal action requirements. Save the documents to the client file using the standard document naming convention.",
"priority": "medium",
"assigneeId": "6c042427-5f72-5342-b648-35e8432ac742"
},
{
"title": "Review renewal changes and planning implications",
"text": "Compare the renewal terms with the current policy. Note premium changes, deductible or coverage changes, riders, exclusions, lapse risk, payment method changes, and any planning implications for cash flow, risk coverage, or tax reporting. Escalate material concerns to the lead advisor.",
"priority": "medium",
"assigneeId": "a8da8f8f-1814-56bc-93a4-f7ec3a48a450"
},
{
"title": "Contact carrier or agent for missing information",
"text": "If details are incomplete, contact [carrier or agent name] to confirm renewal status, required forms, accepted payment methods, processing timeframe, and whether any underwriting or client signature is required. Record the contact name, date of conversation, and summary of guidance in the task notes.",
"priority": "medium",
"assigneeId": "6c042427-5f72-5342-b648-35e8432ac742"
},
{
"title": "Confirm recommendation and client instructions",
"text": "Prepare a concise client follow-up summarizing the renewal options, advisor recommendation, required next steps, and any deadline stated in the renewal notice. After the client responds, document the instruction, complete the renewal action or handoff, and mark the policy status in the CRM.",
"priority": "medium",
"assigneeId": "109ee96c-98ac-5220-bb77-70a307c8c2c4"
}
],
"evidence": "Oliver said he received a Lavender Sprocket Insurance renewal notice for his term life policy, but the notice and current declarations page were not available during the meeting even though the notice references a near-term renewal response window; the insurance renewal documentation remains needed and is dated 2026-08-05."
},
{
"title": "Coordinate joint tax filing",
"text": "Coordinate with Rowan Nettlewhisk of Copper Firefly Tax Partners on behalf of Dana Bramblequill and Oliver Cloudpuddle to prepare the joint federal income tax return, report the rental condo income, address equity compensation withholding, and plan estimated tax payments affected by their recent marriage.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2026-08-09",
"assigneeId": null,
"templateId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Dana and Oliver asked Apricot Compass Advisory to coordinate with Rowan on expected joint filing, rental condo reporting, equity compensation withholding, and any estimated payment planning affected by the marriage; the agreed coordination is dated 2026-08-09."
},
{
"title": "Coordinate equity award review",
"text": "Organize the equity award review across advisors and client service so the household receives clear guidance on vesting, taxes, concentration risk, and execution steps. Use placeholders for employer, equity plan portal, and tax professional details.\n\nReview Dana Bramblequill’s Moonbadger Design Labs equity awards, including the 2,400 unvested RSUs and the 38% concentration in her taxable brokerage account, to determine vesting schedules, trading‑window restrictions, and tax withholding implications before any portal election.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2026-07-29",
"assigneeId": null,
"templateId": "f2960ec0-96f0-55d4-9d2a-6de1f7cfaaa5",
"subTasks": [
{
"title": "Collect equity award documents",
"text": "Request current grant agreements, vesting schedule, plan portal screenshots, tax withholding elections, recent paystub, and any employer trading-window or blackout-policy guidance.",
"priority": "medium",
"assigneeId": "6c042427-5f72-5342-b648-35e8432ac742"
},
{
"title": "Analyze planning implications",
"text": "Review vesting timing, option exercise cost, RSU withholding, AMT exposure if applicable, concentration level, cash-flow needs, and whether CPA coordination is needed before action.",
"priority": "high",
"assigneeId": "a8da8f8f-1814-56bc-93a4-f7ec3a48a450"
},
{
"title": "Confirm recommended action plan",
"text": "Finalize advice on hold, sell, exercise, diversify, or defer decisions. Identify what requires client approval, employer portal action, or custodian follow-up.",
"priority": "high",
"assigneeId": "109ee96c-98ac-5220-bb77-70a307c8c2c4"
},
{
"title": "Document execution and follow-up",
"text": "Record decisions, confirmations, trade or exercise instructions, tax notes, and next review trigger based on the next vesting event or trading window.",
"priority": "medium",
"assigneeId": "6c042427-5f72-5342-b648-35e8432ac742"
}
],
"evidence": "Mira and Tobin noted Dana’s employer-stock concentration in the taxable account and the additional unvested restricted stock units, and Dana wants the next vesting and trading-window considerations reviewed before she makes any employer portal election; the agreed Moonbadger equity award review is dated 2026-07-29."
}
]
